review_question: Which climb/cruise/descent envelope, with its naturally coupled viewing angle, gives the best balance of calm travel and meaningful geographic framing?
review_guidance: Does the camera stay local at the start, tilt progressively downward as it climbs, and travel calmly at cruise?
Does it descend and return to a spatial/local perspective at the destination?
Reject ground racing, delayed tilt correction, excessive height, loss of context, or altitude/tilt pumping.

height_tilt_law.engine_convention: 0deg is nadir/top-down; increasing degrees move toward the horizon
height_tilt_law.interpolation: quintic smootherstep; C2 at practical-height clamps

movement_audit.tilt_changes: only when segment endpoint default changes
movement_audit.defect_risk: high: climb/descent can retain one action-default tilt
high: height phases and tilt phases have separate authority

movement_audit.tilt_changes: fixed action default or explicit endpoint
movement_audit.defect_risk: high-to-close can remain map-like until a later correction
ordinary pull-backs retain fixed tilt; semantic-space is co-sampled
specialized policy; do not replace blindly
initial state is exact; later height changes can drift independently
repeated segment corrections and phase disagreement
